definition: Onyx is an agent and persona powered by a real language model. Routing, retrieval, personality, memory, and tools augment the model; they do not impersonate model inference.

ourspace-ai-brain.completionProof: onyx.chat.aiBrain === true and a non-empty response

ollama.completionProof: POST /api/chat returns a named model and non-empty response

hardRules: A retrieval result is context, never an Onyx chat completion.
A template or canned string may describe an error, never impersonate a successful Onyx answer.
A response without provider-specific model proof is rejected.
The frontend never labels an unverified connection as an LLM connection.

legacy.Onyx/js/chatbot.js: Dormant read-only corpus inspection utility; not imported by the unified runtime and not an Onyx response provider.
